**这是一个始于2023年8月的服务器！**
**This is a server that started in August 2023!**

# 这是一个... | This is a ...
## **有故事的服务器 | A Server with Various Stories**

玩家12qwqqqwww是怎样的人物？ | How is the player 12qwqqqwww?

为什么说腐竹是出生？ | Why many players say the Owner is absurd？

竟然还有管理员擅自删档这样的事情？ | What? Someone of the operators deleated all the server files?

还有很多呢… | ...and so on.

## **开放的服务器 | A Server with an Open Atmosphere**

分享自己的服务器，寻找搭子，参与管理员选举，表现自己的实力…

Share your own server with us, seeking partners, participating in operator election, and showing your gaming abilities...

## **有无限可能的服务器 | A Server with Infinite Possibilities**

- Land服务器在Minecraft方面，运营着生存服和创造服，默默无闻的基岩版服，新生的模组服，还有社区运营的小游戏服。 | Minecraft Land Server operate survival mode and creative mode servers, Bedrock Edition server, newly launched mod servers, and mini-game servers operated by the community.

- Land不止于Minecraft！我们还运营过Counter Strike: Source，Phira多人游戏，Terraria等游戏服务器！ | Land is more than just Minecraft! We have also operated game servers for Counter Strike: Source, Phira Multiplayer, Terraria, and other games!

- Land还会和其他Minecraft服务器达成合作！ | Land will also cooperate with other Minecraft servers!
